leadStory: As of Wednesday evening, Ruud Gullit's verdict on Ryan Gravenberch after the Netherlands' 2-1 win over Serbia, 'isn't comfortable, and neither is Reijnders. It just doesn't click' (TEAMtalk), lands on a midfielder left out of Liverpool's starting side against Forest, Ipswich and Bournemouth, eleven days before Manchester City at Anfield on 11 October.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is a pundit's verdict on an international performance, not a Liverpool still, and STEP 7.5 cannot run from the cloud pass. Antigravity should take no action.
